caption.description: The caption the room reads under the note.

chat.description: The room, by chat id, where it is not this turn's own.

path.description: The path of an OGG/Opus file on this machine.

said.description: What the note says, where the caption is not it.

transcript.description: What was actually read out, where that differs from the caption.

via.description: The road to send on, where it is not the one this turn answers on.

replyTo.description: The message this send replies to, by its number in the room.
